parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance that resides in the classic network.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to which the instance is connected.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs detach-classic-link-vpc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --vpc-id vpc-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
